parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human histone deacetylase 6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering for target name 'Histone deacetylase 6' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
